text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan is studying the lineup for this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Of course, the runners featured in her magazine are other students from the academy. She's seen them training before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She knows them already, so why bother studying?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But on the day of, they all seem completely different to Tosen Jordan. They have an aura about them she's never seen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Intimidated, her legs start trembling. The clash of racing giants that is the Arima Kinen begins.
